title: Cover photoshoot: Walls And Bridges by John Lennon | 1974
content:
The cover photography for John Lennon’s Walls And Bridges album was taken on 28 August 1974.

The shoot took place at Lennon’s apartment at 434 East 52nd Street in Manhattan, New York City. The photographer was Bob Gruen. The final album artwork contained a mix of Gruen’s photography and drawings from Lennon’s school days.

Once the album shots had been taken, Gruen took more photographs of Lennon on the apartment balcony. Lennon wore a New York City t-shirt.
